description: NOMOS Governed x402 on Hedera — From Proof of Payment to Proof of Action
x-runtime-note: evidence-receipt, hcs-anchor, and the mock adapter) still has ZERO
dependencies and runs on Node built-ins alone — `npm test` needs no install.
CP-H2 adds exactly one dependency family, @x402/hedera and its @x402/core
peer, used only by the REAL Hedera path: hedera-signer.ts, real-adapter.ts,
the signer process and the tools/ scripts. Nothing under tests/ imports it,
which is why the test suite keeps working with node_modules deleted.
CP-H7 promotes @hiero-ledger/sdk from a transitive dependency of @x402/hedera
to a direct one, pinned to the exact version @x402/hedera already resolves
(2.85.0), so no new code enters the tree. It is needed because @x402/hedera
re-exports the transfer classes but not the consensus-service ones. It is
imported dynamically, inside the anchor guard's allowed branch only, so an
anchor dry run still loads no SDK at all.
